create_swav_distillation_loss: create a SwAVDistillationLoss instance from an AttrDict config for distilling a SwAV model
build_swav_distillation_criterion: build a SwAVDistillationCriterion with temperature, num_crops, epsilon, and sinkhorn-knopp parameters
compute_teacher_assignments: compute teacher assignments using sinkhorn-knopp algorithm with optional queue stabilization
add_teacher_scores_to_queue: add teacher prototype scores to a local queue for stabilizing sinkhorn-knopp iterations
run_forward_to_teacher_crop: run forward_to_teacher_crop to compute cross-entropy loss between student crop scores and teacher assignments
